svg.aria-label: Three routes to production. The paved road is a wide supported path that already carries authentication, logging, deploys, alarms, cost tags and least-privilege roles, and a request travelling it arrives first. Above and below it, building it yourself and copying another team are dashed paths that reach the same place more slowly and leave you owning what you built. All three are allowed; only one is the default.
svg.text: THREE WAYS TO THE SAME PLACE
